recipes.description: Search Gallica, collect ARKs from typed SRU results, then build a resumable metadata corpus.
notes: Use SearchResults.arks to pass one inspected result page directly to Gallica.corpus().
Use resume=true for repeatable corpus runs.

recipes.description: Iterate lazily over more than one SRU result page without manually managing startRecord.
notes: Use limit when the task needs a bounded number of records.
The iterator performs network requests lazily as records are consumed.

recipes.description: Retrieve ALTO and IIIF images for an explicit set of Gallica views.
notes: Use image_width=1000 unless higher resolution is actually required.
Do not invent an implicit all-pages operation.

recipes.description: Resolve one periodical issue by date, then retrieve its OCR text or search within it.
notes: Periodical.issue may return null when no issue matches the exact date.
Plain text is rate limited by the shared transport.
